name: Dialbubble: Twilio Calls & SMS
subtitle: Second Business Phone Number
promotionalText: Call and text from your own Twilio numbers. Free and open source, with no subscription, no markup and no server in the middle. Try every screen in Demo Mode first.
description:
Dialbubble turns your iPhone into a business phone for the numbers on your own Twilio account. Call and text from any of them, see every conversation in one inbox, and keep your personal number private.

It's free and open source. There's no subscription, no markup and no Dialbubble account. The app talks straight to Twilio, and you pay Twilio's normal usage rates.

Not ready to connect anything? Tap Try the Demo and explore every screen with simulated calls and texts.

CALL FROM ANY OF YOUR NUMBERS
• Talk: Dialbubble rings your iPhone first, you press a key, and only then is the other person dialed. They see your business number, not your personal one
• Voice Message: type what to say and the call speaks it, in a choice of voices
• Play Audio: call and play a recording from a link
• Custom calls: run your own TwiML, with a live preview
• Live call status, step by step, with one-tap hang up. Minimize a call and keep working

EVERY TEXT IN ONE INBOX
• Threaded SMS and MMS conversations across all your numbers
• Pin the people you text most, and keep unsent drafts
• Links, phone numbers and one-time codes become tappable
• Filter by unread, failed, scheduled or number
• Reusable templates for the replies you send most
• Schedule texts through a Twilio Messaging Service
• Broadcast to a list, with progress for each recipient

KNOW WHAT'S HAPPENING
• Balance and usage at a glance, with a low balance warning
• Call history with duration, price and recordings
• Optional alerts for new texts and missed calls, and an app icon badge
• Your recent history stays on your iPhone, so it opens instantly and works offline
• Number lookup for carrier and line type
• Export your calls and texts as a spreadsheet (CSV)
• Errors explained in plain English, with the fix

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your keys are stored only in this iPhone's Keychain
• Requests go directly from your iPhone to Twilio
• No Dialbubble servers, no analytics, no ads, no tracking
• Optional Face ID lock
• Open source: read every line of code on GitHub

SET UP IN ABOUT TWO MINUTES
A guided setup shows where to find your keys, connects your account and imports your numbers. New to Twilio? Dialbubble walks you through signing up.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Real calls and texts need your own Twilio account and at least one Twilio number or verified caller ID. Twilio bills you directly for what you use, and a two-way call is billed as two call legs
• Two-way calls, recording and custom texts need a paid Twilio account. Twilio trial accounts can send voice messages to verified numbers
• Calls connect through your regular phone line, not over the internet
• Alerts use Background App Refresh, so they arrive when iOS allows it, not instantly
• Picture messages need a public https link to the image

Dialbubble is an independent app. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Twilio Inc. Twilio is a trademark of Twilio Inc.
